parameters.text:
You are a YouTube title expert. A creator has this video idea:

"{{ $json.idea }}"

Generate 5 YouTube video titles that would get high engagement. Each title should be from a different angle (curiosity, listicle, emotional, controversial, search-friendly).

Return ONLY a JSON array of strings. No numbering, no extra text.
Example: ["Title 1", "Title 2", "Title 3", "Title 4", "Title 5"]

parameters.responseBody:
={
  "idea": {{ JSON.stringify($json.idea) }},
  "best_title": {{ JSON.stringify($json.best.title) }},
  "best_score": {{ $json.best.score }},
  "started_at": {{ $json.round1Best.score }},
  "final_score": {{ $json.best.score }},
  "improvement": {{ ($json.best.score || 0) - ($json.round1Best.score || 0) }},
  "all_rounds": {{ JSON.stringify($json.allRounds) }},
  "verdict": "Started at {{ $json.round1Best.score }}, best final is {{ $json.best.score }}"
}
